title: A way to compare language models
summary:
Three community projects joined the directory: a model comparison tool, an image-making word game, and a prompt-enhancing image generator.

The project directory added @dseeker’s Pollinations.ai Model Comparison tool, which tests multiple language models in real time with configurable timeouts.

The Social Bots list added @Dimaq21’s One Word Telegram bot. Players try to write the same word at the same time, and the bot generates images from their game words.

The project directory added Zelos AI, a Websim image generator that uses Pollinations to enhance prompts and generate images.
